basic_profile.bio: A 22-year-old college student from Portland, Oregon, majoring in Graphic Design. I've always had a passion for animation and storytelling, which led me to discover subreddits like AvatarVsBattles and Craig of the Creek. I spend most evenings online, especially after classes and during weekends. I'm single and often enjoy binge-watching animated series with my friends or engaging in discussions about character development and plot twists. I dislike overly negative environments and prefer constructive conversations. Currently, I work part-time at a local art supply store, which keeps me connected to my creative interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of animated series, particularly those that focus on character development and intricate world-building like Avatar: The Last Airbender. My knowledge comes from years of watching, engaging in online forums, and reading fan theories. I also have a growing interest in cryptocurrency games, which led me to explore subreddits like CryptoBlades.
